quests.title: Lightkeepers' Oath

dialogue.t: Hello there, friend. A pleasure to meet you again amidst the graves.

dialogue.sit: You describe the "Oath Lantern" you saw and the incomprehensible words inscribed upon it.

dialogue.t: "The winds awaken, the leaves whirl round"... This is the oath those who join the Lightkeepers swear.
Usually, each of us will carry our own lantern, only abandoning our charge to care for it when we have no other choice.
Each masterless lantern, therefore, is a marker of misfortune, a tragedy that fills me with sorrow.
But they knew that such would be their inevitable fate from the moment they made their oaths.
If there was anything else we could do for them, it would be remembering the oaths they made.
To bear and defend "lanterns alight with eternal hope"... That was their dearest wish.

quests.description: This is the pledge all must take when they become Lightkeepers.
